name: Nadi Koota
citation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Chapter 81 Slokas 26-28; Muhurtha Chintamani; Narada Samhita
description: Evaluates physiological, nervous, genetic, and progeny compatibility mapped to Ayurvedic humors (Vata, Pitta, Kapha).

Adi.dosha_description: Vata imbalance; prone to restlessness, nervous stress

Antya.dosha_description: Kapha imbalance; lethargy, fluid balance issues

cancellation_rules.name: Same Rashi, Different Nakshatras
cancellation_rules.description: If both partners have the same Moon Rashi but different Nakshatras, Nadi Dosha is cancelled.

cancellation_rules.name: Same Nakshatra, Different Rashis
cancellation_rules.description: If the Moon falls in the same Nakshatra but spans across two different Rashis, Nadi Dosha is cancelled.

cancellation_rules.name: Exempt Nakshatras List
cancellation_rules.description: Tradition claim exempting Rohini, Mrigashira, Ardra, Punarvasu, Pushya, Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhisha, and Uttara Bhadrapada from severe Nadi Dosha (unverified; traditions differ).

cancellation_rules.name: Different Padas in Same Nakshatra
cancellation_rules.description: If both belong to the same Nakshatra but different quarters (padas), the dosha severity is significantly reduced or cancelled.

cancellation_rules.name: Same or Friendly Moon Lords
cancellation_rules.description: When Moon sign lords are the same or mutual friends and Gana / Bhakoot are favorable, Nadi Dosha is mitigated.
